planned_slot_overrides.57.text: One freestanding communal water pump housing for a quiet lakeside observatory settlement, an original practical industrial design. Waist-high, broad stable base, compact rounded rectangular casing, muted lake-green painted metal with modest wear, warm brass inlet and outlet fittings, a clearly readable rectangular service panel, one carefully replaced coupling and a restrained repair patch. Mounted on a low pale stone footing. Large simple forms, understandable construction, clear silhouette, enough separation between fittings to read their shapes. The object feels useful, maintained, and approachable. Three-quarter front view showing the entire object, neutral light gray background, soft even studio illumination, restrained realistic materials. Static housing only, with a small mounting socket for a separately modeled service lever. No moving lever, water spray, people, surrounding buildings, landscape, lettering, logos, ornate decoration, dramatic shadows, or multiple objects.

review.feedback_scope: Positive initial reaction to the concept; detailed design and game-asset acceptance remain open.
observations: Single complete object with clear green painted housing, brass fittings, pale stone footing, panel, and readable silhouette.
Surface is mostly pristine; repair patch and deliberately replaced coupling are not evident. Maintenance history does not yet read as intended.
Housing is taller and slimmer than the brief's compact broad form. Inlet/outlet construction and a distinct lever socket need clarification before modeling.
Neutral background and three-quarter presentation are useful for design review. A directional ground shadow and small fastener details remain. No moving lever or water effect appears.
review.performance_notes: Concept image only; no mesh, engine import, or target-PC benchmark performed.
review.next_change: Preserve this promising baseline. A later recorded iteration can make the repair patch explicit, clarify the lever socket, and consider a broader housing.
acceptance_checks: Readable complete housing, broad base, distinct service panel, separated fittings, and lever socket without implausibly fused parts.
Modest wear, replacement coupling, and repair patch express care; muted lake green, warm brass, and pale stone fit the village.
Simple silhouette, neutral background, even light, no cropping or extra moving parts; panel and socket remain legible at quarter size.
